description: Match standards to an engineering goal (pass question/q and/or use_case + audience filters). Returns { question, matched_use_cases, standards (active matches: id, name, step, tier, lifecycle_status, phase, url), retired_or_superseded, avoid (alias of retired_or_superseded), comparisons }. Use ask to see which standards match a goal; use search for keyword lookup or get for one standard's record.

audience.description: target audience filter (site-owner, agent-builder, platform, standards-body)

q.description: alias for question: natural-language implementation question

question.description: natural-language implementation question (e.g. How do I accept payments from agents?)

name: ask
title: What should I implement?
